import json, os
E=W('model.embed_tokens.weight'); norm=W('model.norm.weight'); U=E*norm; U=torch.nn.functional.normalize(U,dim=1)
groups={'digits':list(range(15,25)), 'operators':sorted(set(t for s in ['+','-','=','*','/','%',' multiply',' divided',' sum',' total',' equals',' product',' difference',' fraction',' calculate','\\frac','\\times'] for t in encode(s))), 'prose':sorted(set(t for s in [' the',' a',' and',' of',' in',' was',' is',' by',' that',' from',' city',' history',' author',' country',' book',' people',' Paris',' London'] for t in encode(s)))}
print({k:decode(v) for k,v in groups.items()})
G={k:U[v] for k,v in groups.items()}; I=torch.nn.functional.normalize(E[groups['digits']+groups['operators']],dim=1)
metrics={}; headrows=[]
for l in range(28):
 p=f'model.layers.{l}.'; D=W(p+'mlp.down_proj.weight'); dn=D.norm(dim=0); Dn=D/dn.clamp_min(1e-8)
 proj={k:(v@Dn).square().mean(0).sqrt() for k,v in G.items()}
 gate=W(p+'mlp.gate_proj.weight'); up=W(p+'mlp.up_proj.weight')
 read=((I@torch.nn.functional.normalize(gate,dim=1).T).square().mean(0)+(I@torch.nn.functional.normalize(up,dim=1).T).square().mean(0)).sqrt()
 select=(proj['digits']+proj['operators']-2*proj['prose'])*read
 metrics[l]={'score':select,'write_digits':proj['digits'],'write_ops':proj['operators'],'write_prose':proj['prose'],'read':read,'down_norm':dn}
 best=select.topk(64).indices
 print('MLP',l,'down_norm mean/max',round(dn.mean().item(),3),round(dn.max().item(),3),'top64 digit/op/prose/read',*[round(x[best].mean().item(),4) for x in [proj['digits'],proj['operators'],proj['prose'],read]],'top8',select.topk(8).indices.tolist())
 O=W(p+'self_attn.o_proj.weight'); V=W(p+'self_attn.v_proj.weight')
 for h in range(12):
  Oh=O[:,h*128:(h+1)*128]; Vh=V[(h//6)*128:(h//6+1)*128]
  OV=Oh@Vh
  nr={k:(v@OV).norm(dim=1).mean().item() for k,v in G.items()}
  headrows.append({'layer':l,'head':h,**nr,'selective':nr['digits']+nr['operators']-2*nr['prose']})
torch.save(metrics,'/work/weight_metrics.pt'); json.dump(headrows,open('/work/head_weights.json','w'))
print('HEADS strongest digit/operator OV writes')
for row in sorted(headrows,key=lambda x:x['selective'],reverse=True)[:20]: print(row)

args.label: math_reasoning_L22_activation256
args.weight_rationale: Initial down-projection/unembedding inspection identified arithmetic-aligned writes around layers 19–24, including product/multiplication in layer 22. Within this activation-ranked layer-22 cluster, gate rows 1739, 1009 and 6185 align with digits and number words (two/three, twenty/forty/thirty, four/five/dozen), supporting a number-reading hypothesis rather than the generic late-layer digit-writing hypothesis rejected by controls.

args.label: math_reasoning_L22_activation512
args.weight_rationale: Raw-weight projections suggested arithmetic-related MLP structure around layers 19–24, with layer-22 product/multiplication writers. The cluster's leading gate rows include number readers 1739 (digits and small number words), 1009 (decade words), and 6185 (four/five/three/dozen); activation-based expansion captures a selectively math-important group whose ablation spares numbers in prose, unlike layer-27 digit writers.

args.label: math_reasoning_L22_activation384
args.weight_rationale: Weight inspection located arithmetic-token-aligned MLP writes in layer 22 and number-reading gate rows among this activation-ranked cluster's leading members: 1739 reads digits/small number words, 1009 reads decade words, and 6185 reads quantities such as four/five/dozen. This intermediate prefix tests whether the validated 512-neuron group's math-selective effect persists at smaller size; no specific arithmetic algorithm is inferred from these projections.

args.summary: Found two validated math-selective MLP clusters in zero-indexed layer 22 of Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B. Smallest passing tested part: cand5:384, top 384 neurons by math-minus-control activation (4.29% of the layer's 8960 neurons), catalog mlp_math_reasoning_l22_activation384_qwenmath1.5b_L22_k384_001. GSM8K generation relative drops zero/mean: 40.47%/45.24%; held-out: 42.86%/40.47%. Largest control drop 1.20%; exceeded all returned same-layer random baselines. cand5:512 also passed, catalog mlp_math_reasoning_l22_activation512_qwenmath1.5b_L22_k512_001, with held-out generation drops 52.39%/40.47%, max control drop 1.72%. cand5:256 failed only held-out mean generation threshold (28.57%). Weight inspection first identified arithmetic-related writes near layers 19–24, and number-reading gates in leading layer-22 cluster members; activation and ablation provided causal task evidence. Late-layer digit-writing candidates damaged wiki_digits without reducing math accuracy and were rejected. Results support benchmark-selective math importance, not identification of a complete arithmetic algorithm.
